title: Keep your place in a guide
summary: A small test update checks what happens when you pick a guide step. The checks passed, but the intended behavior needs your review.

evidence.checks: 12 sanitized fixture checks passed. These illustrate recorded evidence; no addon or game files were loaded.
evidence.caveat: Passing checks do not establish the intended player experience. Review each behavior below.

claims.text: Following tracks the current step. Picking another step keeps it selected as progress changes.
If your picked step no longer applies, the guide returns to following the current step.
A finished guide shows the last required step, leaving out any optional step after it.

evidence.excerpt:
Fixture contract v1
Follow the current step unless a valid step is picked.
When the picked step stops applying, return to following.
At completion, show the last required step.
